subject.title: Sunnyvale School District Board, Trustee Area 3

text: As a classroom teacher, I see every day how important strong schools are to our children, families, and community. I understand the needs of students, the dedication of teachers, and the partnership families want with their schools.

My years in special education and working with multilingual students have reinforced a simple belief that every student is capable of growth and achievement. When schools combine high expectations with the right support, students of every background and ability can thrive.

I am running to help ensure that every student has a safe, supportive, and high-quality learning environment. I believe in strong academic foundations, student well-being, transparent communication, and responsible use of district resources. Our schools should prepare children not only to succeed in the classroom, but also to grow with confidence and respect for others.
School board decisions shape what happens in our classrooms every day. I will bring the perspective of someone who understands those realities because I have lived them as an educator.

text: Governing Board Member, Sunnyvale School District
I am grateful to have served the students and community of the Sunnyvale School District as a School Board member for the last ten years, including two years as Board President.
As a lifelong resident who attended Cumberland, Sunnyvale Middle, and Fremont High School, and as a parent in the district, my commitment to our community is deeply-rooted.
I will continue to fight for our youth and ensure we are actively addressing the needs of all of our students.

As a Board Member, I have successfully advocated for programs and resources that prepare our students for high school, college, and beyond. I have championed our children's needs locally, as well as at the State and Federal levels.

I am energized by our progress and the direction we are headed. If re-elected, I will remain fiercely committed to eliminating the persistent achievement gaps, ensuring fiscal responsibility, and empowering family/parent engagement. Together, we can ensure every student's well-being and academic success.
I would be honored to receive your support and your vote.
